This page demonstrates the clinical utility of ALIGATEHR-Gen through a focused case study on seven fibrotic diseases: CKD, Cardiac Fibrosis, MASH, Pulmonary Fibrosis, SSc/Connective Tissue, Crohn's Disease, and Fibrosis of Skin.

## Patient Embeddings — 7 Fibrotic Diseases

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

fibroticData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/fibrotic_patient_embeddings.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

observableDrilldownPlot = {
  function fitWidth(maxWidth = 1000) {
    const main = document.querySelector("main.content") || document.querySelector("main");
    const mainWidth = main?.clientWidth || maxWidth;
    const viewportWidth = document.documentElement.clientWidth - 32;
    return Math.floor(Math.min(maxWidth, Math.max(320, Math.min(mainWidth, viewportWidth))));
  }

  function extentFor(data, xField, yField, pad = 0.08) {
    const xExtent = d3.extent(data, d => +d[xField]);
    const yExtent = d3.extent(data, d => +d[yField]);
    const xSpan = (xExtent[1] - xExtent[0]) || 1;
    const ySpan = (yExtent[1] - yExtent[0]) || 1;
    return {
      x: [xExtent[0] - xSpan * pad, xExtent[1] + xSpan * pad],
      y: [yExtent[0] - ySpan * pad, yExtent[1] + ySpan * pad],
    };
  }

  function localRegion(data, point, domain, xField, yField, scale = 0.46) {
    const xSpan = (domain.x[1] - domain.x[0]) * scale;
    const ySpan = (domain.y[1] - domain.y[0]) * scale;
    const x0 = +point[xField] - xSpan / 2;
    const x1 = +point[xField] + xSpan / 2;
    const y0 = +point[yField] - ySpan / 2;
    const y1 = +point[yField] + ySpan / 2;
    const selected = data.filter(d => +d[xField] >= x0 && +d[xField] <= x1 && +d[yField] >= y0 && +d[yField] <= y1);
    return selected.length ? selected : [point];
  }

  return function(config) {
    const width = fitWidth(config.width || 1000);
    const height = config.height || 650;
    const marginLeft = config.marginLeft || 40;
    const marginRight = config.marginRight || 20;
    const marginTop = config.marginTop || 20;
    const marginBottom = config.marginBottom || 40;

    const container = document.createElement("div");
    container.className = "drilldown-shell";

    const titleDiv = document.createElement("div");
    titleDiv.innerHTML = `<strong style="font-size:1.1rem;color:#2c3e50;">${config.title}</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;">${config.subtitle}</span>`;
    titleDiv.style.marginBottom = "8px";
    container.appendChild(titleDiv);

    const plotFrame = document.createElement("div");
    plotFrame.className = "drilldown-plot-frame";
    container.appendChild(plotFrame);

    const controls = document.createElement("div");
    controls.className = "drilldown-controls";
    const status = document.createElement("span");
    status.className = "drilldown-status";
    const backBtn = document.createElement("button");
    backBtn.className = "drilldown-button";
    backBtn.textContent = "Back";
    const resetBtn = document.createElement("button");
    resetBtn.className = "drilldown-button";
    resetBtn.textContent = "Reset zoom";
    controls.append(status, backBtn, resetBtn);
    container.appendChild(controls);

    const legendDiv = document.createElement("div");
    legendDiv.className = "drilldown-legend";
    container.appendChild(legendDiv);

    let stack = [{
      data: config.data,
      label: "Overview",
      filters: {},
      domain: extentFor(config.data, config.xField, config.yField),
    }];

    function current() {
      return stack[stack.length - 1];
    }

    function makeState(data, label, filters) {
      return { data, label, filters, domain: extentFor(data, config.xField, config.yField) };
    }

    function syncControls() {
      const labels = stack.map(d => d.label).join(" / ");
      status.textContent = `${labels} - ${current().data.length.toLocaleString()} ${config.countNoun || "points"}`;
      backBtn.disabled = stack.length <= 1;
      resetBtn.disabled = stack.length <= 1;
      container.classList.toggle("is-focused", stack.length > 1);
    }

    function drillGroup(value) {
      if (!config.groupField) return;
      const data = config.data.filter(d => d[config.groupField] === value);
      stack.push(makeState(data, config.groupLabel(value), { group: value }));
      render();
    }

    function drillDatum(d) {
      const state = current();
      if (config.groupField && !state.filters.group && d[config.groupField] != null) {
        drillGroup(d[config.groupField]);
        return;
      }
      if (config.subgroupField && !state.filters.subgroup && d[config.subgroupField] != null) {
        const value = d[config.subgroupField];
        const data = state.data.filter(row => row[config.subgroupField] === value);
        stack.push(makeState(data, config.subgroupLabel(value), { ...state.filters, subgroup: value }));
        render();
        return;
      }
      const data = localRegion(state.data, d, state.domain, config.xField, config.yField, config.regionScale);
      stack.push(makeState(data, `Region ${stack.length}`, { ...state.filters, region: stack.length }));
      render();
    }

    function pointFromEvent(event, domain) {
      let px;
      let py;
      if (event.currentTarget.createSVGPoint) {
        const point = event.currentTarget.createSVGPoint();
        point.x = event.clientX;
        point.y = event.clientY;
        const svgPoint = point.matrixTransform(event.currentTarget.getScreenCTM().inverse());
        px = svgPoint.x;
        py = svgPoint.y;
      } else {
        const rect = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
        px = (event.clientX - rect.left) * (width / rect.width);
        py = (event.clientY - rect.top) * (height / rect.height);
      }
      if (px < marginLeft || px > width - marginRight || py < marginTop || py > height - marginBottom) return null;
      const innerWidth = width - marginLeft - marginRight;
      const innerHeight = height - marginTop - marginBottom;
      return {
        [config.xField]: domain.x[0] + ((px - marginLeft) / innerWidth) * (domain.x[1] - domain.x[0]),
        [config.yField]: domain.y[1] - ((py - marginTop) / innerHeight) * (domain.y[1] - domain.y[0]),
        __px: px,
        __py: py,
      };
    }

    function nearestDatum(data, point, domain) {
      const innerWidth = width - marginLeft - marginRight;
      const innerHeight = height - marginTop - marginBottom;
      let best = null;
      let bestDistance = Infinity;
      for (const d of data) {
        const px = marginLeft + ((+d[config.xField] - domain.x[0]) / (domain.x[1] - domain.x[0])) * innerWidth;
        const py = marginTop + (1 - ((+d[config.yField] - domain.y[0]) / (domain.y[1] - domain.y[0]))) * innerHeight;
        const distance = (px - point.__px) ** 2 + (py - point.__py) ** 2;
        if (distance < bestDistance) {
          bestDistance = distance;
          best = d;
        }
      }
      return best;
    }

    function renderLegend(state) {
      legendDiv.innerHTML = "";
      if (!config.legendValues?.length) return;
      legendDiv.style.cssText = config.legendStyle || "display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;";
      for (const value of config.legendValues) {
        const count = state.data.filter(d => d[config.groupField] === value).length;
        if (!count) continue;
        const item = document.createElement("span");
        item.className = "drilldown-legend-item";
        item.tabIndex = 0;
        item.innerHTML = `<span style="display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:${config.legendColor(value)};margin-right:4px;vertical-align:middle;"></span>${config.legendLabel(value, count)}`;
        item.addEventListener("click", () => drillGroup(value));
        item.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
          if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
            event.preventDefault();
            drillGroup(value);
          }
        });
        legendDiv.appendChild(item);
      }
    }

    function render() {
      const state = current();
      const chart = Plot.plot({
        width,
        height,
        marginLeft,
        marginRight,
        marginTop,
        marginBottom,
        x: { label: config.xLabel, domain: state.domain.x },
        y: { label: config.yLabel, domain: state.domain.y },
        marks: [
          Plot.dot(state.data, {
            x: config.xField,
            y: config.yField,
            fill: d => config.color(d),
            fillOpacity: d => config.opacity ? config.opacity(d) : 0.75,
            r: d => config.radius ? config.radius(d) : 3,
            stroke: d => config.stroke ? config.stroke(d) : "none",
            strokeWidth: config.strokeWidth || 0.5,
            tip: true,
            title: d => config.tooltip(d),
          }),
        ],
      });
      plotFrame.replaceChildren(chart);
      plotFrame.animate([{ opacity: 0.45 }, { opacity: 1 }], { duration: 180, easing: "ease-out" });
      chart.querySelectorAll("circle").forEach((node, index) => {
        const datum = state.data[index];
        if (!datum) return;
        node.style.cursor = "zoom-in";
        node.tabIndex = 0;
        node.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
          if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
            event.preventDefault();
            drillDatum(datum);
          }
        });
      });
      chart.addEventListener("click", event => {
        const point = pointFromEvent(event, state.domain);
        if (!point) return;
        drillDatum(nearestDatum(state.data, point, state.domain) || point);
      });
      renderLegend(state);
      syncControls();
    }

    backBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (stack.length <= 1) return;
      stack.pop();
      render();
    });
    resetBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      stack = [{
        data: config.data,
        label: "Overview",
        filters: {},
        domain: extentFor(config.data, config.xField, config.yField),
      }];
      render();
    });

    render();
    return container;
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

fibroticUmap = {
  const diseaseList = [...new Set(fibroticData.map(d => d.disease))];
  const tableau7 = [
    "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728",
    "#9467bd", "#8c564b", "#e377c2"
  ];
  const diseaseColorMap = {};
  diseaseList.forEach((d, i) => { diseaseColorMap[d] = tableau7[i]; });

  const displayName = name => name.replace(/_/g, " ");

  return observableDrilldownPlot({
    data: fibroticData,
    xField: "tsne_x",
    yField: "tsne_y",
    xLabel: "t-SNE 1",
    yLabel: "t-SNE 2",
    title: "Patient Embeddings — 7 Fibrotic Diseases",
    subtitle: `t-SNE of learned representations, coloured by fibrotic disease (${fibroticData.length.toLocaleString()} patients)`,
    groupField: "disease",
    groupLabel: value => displayName(value),
    subgroupField: "group",
    subgroupLabel: value => `Purity: ${value}`,
    countNoun: "patients",
    color: d => diseaseColorMap[d.disease],
    opacity: () => 0.7,
    radius: () => 3,
    tooltip: d => `ID: ${d.eid}\nDisease: ${displayName(d.disease)} (${d.abbrev})\nAge: ${d.age_recruit} · Sex: ${d.is_male === 1 ? "Male" : "Female"}\nBMI: ${d.BMI} · Purity: ${d.group}\nP(true): ${Number(d.p_true).toFixed(3)}`,
    legendValues: diseaseList,
    legendColor: value => diseaseColorMap[value],
    legendLabel: (value, count) => `${displayName(value)} (n=${count.toLocaleString()})`,
  });
}
```

## Top Risk Factors by Disease

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

featureData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/feature_importance.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

fibroticDiseaseList = [...new Set(featureData.map(d => d.disease))]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof featureDisease = Inputs.select(fibroticDiseaseList, { label: "Disease", value: fibroticDiseaseList[0] })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

featureChart = {
  const filtered = featureData
    .filter(d => d.disease === featureDisease && d.rank <= 15)
    .sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 1000,
    height: 420,
    marginLeft: 220,
    marginRight: 20,
    x: { label: "Importance Score", grid: true },
    y: { label: null, domain: filtered.map(d => d.feature) },
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(filtered, {
        x: "importance_score",
        y: "feature",
        fill: "#2c5aa0",
        tip: true,
        title: d => `${d.feature}\nImportance: ${d.importance_score.toFixed(4)}\nRank: #${d.rank}\nDisease: ${d.disease}`,
      }),
    ],
  });

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  const titleDiv = document.createElement("div");
  titleDiv.innerHTML = `<strong style="font-size:1.1rem;color:#2c3e50;">Top Risk Factors — ${featureDisease}</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;">Top 15 features by global importance score</span>`;
  titleDiv.style.marginBottom = "8px";
  container.appendChild(titleDiv);
  container.appendChild(chart);

  return container;
}
```

## Pathway Enrichment Analysis

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

pathwayData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/pathway_enrichment.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof pathwayDisease = Inputs.select(fibroticDiseaseList, { label: "Disease", value: fibroticDiseaseList[0] })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

pathwayChart = {
  const filtered = pathwayData
    .filter(d => d.disease === pathwayDisease && d.rank <= 15)
    .sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);

  // Compute -log10(p_adjusted) for color encoding
  const withLogP = filtered.map(d => ({
    ...d,
    neg_log10_padj: -Math.log10(d.p_adjusted),
  }));

  const minER = d3.min(withLogP, d => d.enrichment_ratio);
  const maxER = d3.max(withLogP, d => d.enrichment_ratio);
  const xPad = (maxER - minER) * 0.12;

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 1000,
    height: 480,
    marginLeft: 280,
    marginRight: 20,
    x: { label: "Enrichment Ratio", grid: true, domain: [minER - xPad, maxER + xPad * 0.3] },
    y: {
      label: null,
      domain: withLogP.map(d => d.pathway),
    },
    r: { range: [4, 16], label: "Gene Count" },
    color: { scheme: "YlOrRd", label: "-log₁₀(p adjusted)", legend: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.dot(withLogP, {
        x: "enrichment_ratio",
        y: "pathway",
        r: "gene_count",
        fill: "neg_log10_padj",
        stroke: "#dee2e6",
        strokeWidth: 0.5,
        tip: true,
        title: d => `${d.pathway}\nSource: ${d.source}\nGene Count: ${d.gene_count}\nEnrichment Ratio: ${d.enrichment_ratio.toFixed(2)}\nP-value: ${Number(d.p_value).toExponential(2)}\nAdj. P-value: ${Number(d.p_adjusted).toExponential(2)}`,
      }),
    ],
  });

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  const titleDiv = document.createElement("div");
  titleDiv.innerHTML = `<strong style="font-size:1.1rem;color:#2c3e50;">Pathway Enrichment — ${pathwayDisease}</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;">Top 15 pathways by significance · Dot size = gene count · Color = -log₁₀(adj. p-value)</span>`;
  titleDiv.style.marginBottom = "8px";
  container.appendChild(titleDiv);
  container.appendChild(chart);

  return container;
}
```
